verdict.rationale: The Admin API explicitly offers Console parity for members, workspaces, invites and API keys, and the Usage & Cost API, Messages API, code execution, skills and managed agents expose much of what users do interactively. But the evidence shows UI-only surfaces: workspace geo is configured in the Console, and data export runs from claude.ai web or Desktop. Consumer UI features such as Memory, Projects and Design/Slides/Docs have no documented API equivalents. missing for 10: API control of workspace geo, programmatic data export, API equivalents for claude.ai Memory/Projects/Design features, a documented UI-to-API parity statement or independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Admin API lets you manage your organization's members, workspaces, invites, and API keys programmatically instead of by hand in the Claude Console
The Usage & Cost Admin API provides programmatic and granular access to historical API usage and cost data for your organization
Run Python and bash code in a sandboxed container to analyze data, generate files, and iterate on solutions.
